rationale: The agent executed an exchange without obtaining explicit user confirmation beforehand, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The replacement camera does not keep all other specifications the same (MP changed from 24MP to 30MP), which contradicts the user's constraints. The agent also did not demonstrate that the chosen camera has the maximum zoom capacity; selecting a 10x zoom model is not evidenced as the maximum. Additionally, the price difference charged to PayPal and the completion confirmation appear without shown supporting tool results or user confirmation. While the agent did look up user/order info, the critical policy steps (confirmation before write, adherence to constraints, avoiding unsupported claims) were not met.
